scribe.text: Please sign the permission slip for Maya R. to attend the Harbor View Elementary (demo) trip. An amount of $88.00 is held on PayPal and not charged unless the trip runs with at least 18 children. The cost falls as more children join, it never goes above the held amount, and the final decision will be made on 2026-11-13.

Para Maya R. en Harbor View Elementary (demo), la cantidad de $88.00 está retenida en PayPal pero no se ha cobrado aún. Solo se cargará el dinero si el viaje se realiza con 18 alumnos, lo cual se decidirá el 2026-11-13. El costo bajará si se unen más niños y nunca superará el monto retenido.

Chào bạn, chúng tôi đang tạm giữ số tiền $88.00 trên PayPal cho chuyến đi của Maya R. tại Harbor View Elementary (demo) nhưng chưa thực hiện trừ tiền. Số tiền này chỉ được thu nếu chuyến đi diễn ra với tối thiểu 18 trẻ em và mức phí sẽ giảm xuống khi có thêm nhiều trẻ em tham gia. Quyết định sẽ có vào 2026-11-13 và bạn hãy yên tâm rằng chi phí sẽ không bao giờ vượt quá số tiền đang được tạm giữ.

clerk.q: Why is my hold $88.00 if the trip costs less?
clerk.answer: The current share per child is $80.00. Your hold is $88.00 to cover potential cost changes. The teacher decides the final charge in The Register. Any amount above the final share will not be charged.

clerk.q: How much was each family charged, and were the vendors paid exactly?
clerk.answer: The model is busy right now, so this is a template answer from the trip's facts. The trip "Live run, 20 families" has 20 of 18 children held. Each family's PayPal holds $88.00, the most it can ever cost. If the trip closed now each family would pay $80.00. At the close families were charged $1600.00 in total and the vendors were paid $1600.00, exact to the cent. The rest of every hold is released at the close.
